settings.heading: Your Safety, Our Priority
settings.body_text: We publish recalls openly. If you ever own an affected product, here's exactly how to check, what to do, and how we'll put things right.

settings.heading: Safety Is Never Optional
settings.body: If a product is ever found to fall short of our standards, we act immediately — stop-sale, customer notifications, public recall notice, regulator coordination and a swift remedy for you.
